public_rationale: The named case holds. Amazon planned to launch a generative-AI Alexa in October 2024, but it did not happen, and as of January 2025 there was still no release date (e1). Amazon's AI lead cited hallucinations as a key hurdle (e2). So during 2024, LLMs did not markedly improve Alexa for users. The main counterpoint is Google: it rolled out Gemini Live, an LLM-based replacement for Google Assistant, to Android users in 2024 (e3). Whether that counts as a marked improvement to a commercial assistant depends on reading 'like Alexa' broadly, and the cited source does not judge its quality. On the plain reading centred on Alexa, the claim is supported.
limitations: Relies on news reports, not Amazon statements.
Quality of Gemini Live and Siri changes in 2024 not assessed.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: LLMs did not markedly improve commercial assistants like Amazon Alexa during 2024.

statement.excerpt: My November 2022 prediction that LLMs would not immediately markedly improve commercial AI agents like Amazon Alexa continued to hold throughout 2024.
statement.document_title: 25 AI Predictions for 2025, from Marcus on AI

from_speaker: LLMs would not immediately markedly improve commercial AI agents like Amazon Alexa
our_interpretation: Plain reading: during 2024, mainstream voice assistants (Alexa, Siri, Google Assistant) did not get a shipped, LLM-driven upgrade that made them markedly better for users. Alexa is the named test case.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence that Amazon did not ship its LLM-powered Alexa in 2024, and no evidence that a comparable assistant was markedly improved by LLMs that year.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence that Alexa or a comparable commercial assistant shipped an LLM upgrade in 2024 that was widely judged markedly better.

evidence.excerpt: Amazon had been planning to roll out a new Alexa powered by generative AI in October 2024, but that obviously didn't happen.
evidence.explanation: The LLM-powered Alexa was not released in 2024. So LLMs did not improve the named assistant that year.

evidence.excerpt: Hallucinations have to be "close to zero," Rohit Prasad, leader of Amazon's artificial general intelligence (AGI) team told FT.
evidence.explanation: Amazon's AI lead cited hallucinations as a reason for the delay, which is consistent with the claim's reasoning.

evidence.excerpt: Gemini Live is billed as a “mobile conversational experience” and is the AI-powered replacement for Google Assistant.
evidence.explanation: Google shipped an LLM-based replacement for Google Assistant to Android users in 2024. This is the strongest counterpoint, but the source does not show it was markedly better at assistant tasks.
